If the cause is uncertain, choose an observation that distinguishes plausible causes before changing the cluster. Finish as soon as the outcome is verified. The rollout was successful, meaning the Deployment configuration was updated and the system is now configured to pull the latest version of the image referenced by that tag. The original symptom (Pods not running the published image) is resolved by this change.

You should avoid using the `:latest` tag when deploying containers in production as
